about.title: Background
about.intro: Double master's in project management and full-stack development. Several years in permanent roles on Symfony / Vue projects, with real passion for modern interfaces and clean architectures.
paragraphs: Full-stack developer with several years of permanent role experience, I work primarily on Symfony / Nuxt stacks. I'm bilingual French / English, which allows me to collaborate with both French-speaking and English-speaking teams.
I'm available evenings and weekends for freelance remote projects. My approach: I integrate smoothly into your existing workflow (Git, PRs, reviews), without friction.

offers.title: Offers
offers.subtitle: Simple formats, adapted for efficient collaboration: clear scope, transparent communication, regular delivery.
offers.disclaimer:
Every project is different.
A call is worth a thousand messages! We clarify the context and impact area, then I confirm a rate adapted to complexity, timeline, and urgency.

proof.title: Projects
proof.subtitle: Two concrete projects, delivered in real conditions.

items.title: Migration of legacy internal tool to Symfony / Vue
items.context: Internal tool in native PHP, unmaintained, no clear structure.
items.problem: Code impossible to evolve, zero separation of concerns, no tests, security risks.
items.actions: Complete rewrite from scratch: Symfony API, Vue front-end, clean architecture setup, authentication, deployment.
items.result: Fully operational tool, team able to evolve the codebase smoothly, technical debt eliminated.

items.title: WordPress brochure website — Architecture agency
items.context: Agency wanting to redesign its brochure site to better showcase its projects.
items.problem: Existing site outdated, poorly structured, unresponsive, no SEO optimization.
items.actions: In collaboration with a designer, development of a custom WordPress theme: modern design, clear structure, responsive, SEO optimization, team training for maintenance.
items.result: Modern, fast, well-ranked website — delivered on schedule.

items.title: Portfolio
items.context: Need for a clear and professional portfolio to showcase my offers and projects.
items.problem: No portfolio, difficulty presenting my skills and experience in a structured way.
items.actions: Design and development of a modern Nuxt portfolio, with smooth navigation, clear presentation of my offers, and dedicated project section.
items.result: Professional, easy-to-navigate portfolio that effectively showcases my skills and experience.
